en.sayed-ali-raza: Then, very often check his decisions
and allow him so much money (as remuneration) that he has no excuse worth hearing (for not being honest) and there remains no occasion for him to go to others for his needs.
Give him that rank in your audience for which no one else among your chiefs aspires,
so that he remains safe from the harm of those around you.

You should have a piercing eye in this matter because this religion has formerly been a prisoner in the hands of vicious persons when action was taken according to passion, and worldly wealth was sought.
